name: concept-learning
description: Research-first Java/Spring explanations with stronger claim-source alignment, genuine inline visuals and textbook insights; concise summaries remain available.

interface.shortDescription: Explain with verified evidence and real visuals, or summarize.
interface.longDescription: An early-career Java/Spring teaching plugin. EXPLAIN cross-checks each important claim against genuinely relevant Korean developer/Tecoble/engineering content, uses rights-respecting actual instructional images rather than favicon or image links, integrates verified textbook ideas into the relevant section, and checks that examples actually demonstrate the behavior. SUMMARIZE keeps concise core concepts and selective resources. Research-first guidance and pre-answer QA, no runtime QA hook or automated publishing.
capabilities: Research and teach Java/Spring mechanisms with direct claim-source alignment and design tradeoffs
Prioritize substantive, rights-appropriate instructional images embedded and explained in context
Verify example behavior and relevant book insights in EXPLAIN while preserving concise SUMMARIZE mode
